declarations.type:

            (H y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H y)‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          ∀ {T : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
            {K : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} {C γ : ℝ},
            Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsResidualField T K C γ →
              ∀ {p : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialData},
                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsPotentialData p C →
                  ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (T σ) MeasureTheory.volume →
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => inner ℝ (v y) (T σ y)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => inner ℝ (Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H y)) (p.theta σ y))
                            MeasureTheory.volume ∧

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P Pc : ℝ) (rate q : Fin k → ℝ) (E : Finset (Fin k)) (W c e ζ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)

  1 / P = 1 / Pc + ∑ i, q i * rate i →
    (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), W σ y = c σ y + ∑ i ∈ E, q i • b i σ y + e σ y) →
      (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), DifferentiableAt ℝ (c σ) y) →
        (∀ i ∈ E, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), DifferentiableAt ℝ (b i σ) y) →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), DifferentiableAt ℝ (e σ) y) →
            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              Breakdown.AdjointDefect.adjointTransport P W ζ σ y =
                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.adjointTransport Pc c ζ σ y +
                      ∑ i ∈ E,
                        q i •
                          (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.advectionShift (b i) ζ σ y -
                            rate i • Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative ζ σ y) +
                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.advectionShift e ζ σ y -

declarations.type:

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.bases_eq
Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.bases_valid
Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.box_eq
Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.box_valid
Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
          {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L → Sort u} →
              (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) →
                ((order_eq : L.order = c.order) →
                    (box_eq : L.box = K) →
                      (bases_eq : L.bases = B) →
                        (modes_eq : L.modes = S.resolved) →
                          (degCoef_eq : L.degCoef = S.degHigh) →
                            (degSide_eq : L.degSide = S.degLow) →
                              (box_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K) →
                                (bases_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B) →
                                  (segment_valid :
                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                                    (presSegment_valid :
                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                                      (gauge_valid :
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧
                                            L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo) →
                                        (segment_on_side :
                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                              (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧
                                                      (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                                                ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                                    K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                                          (segment_other_in_box :
                                              ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                                  (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                                            (corner_is_corner :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                  ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧
                                                      (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                                              (corner_other :
                                                  ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                    (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                                      (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                                (segEnd_spec :
                                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                      L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                                        L.corner c =
                                                          if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                                            ((L.segment s).level,
                                                              if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                                          else
                                                            (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi,
                                                              (L.segment s).level)) →
                                                  (segEnd_axis :
                                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                                        L.segEnd s e = none →
                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                                    (radial_test_const :
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                          (L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (height_test_affine :
                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                            ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                                (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                                        (degSide_pos : 1 ≤ L.degSide) →
                                                          (degSide_le : L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef) →
                                                            (cellCorner_spec :
                                                                ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                                  L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                                    L.corner c =
                                                                      (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂,
                                                                        if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                                              (cellCorner_axis :
                                                                  ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                    L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                                (sideSegments_spec :
                                                                    ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                      ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                        ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                                          (L.segment s).level =
                                                                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                                            else
                                                                              if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂
                                                                              else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                                  (sideSegments_cover :
                                                                      ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                        (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                                          ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                                            (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                                              else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                                              ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                                (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧
                                                                                  u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                                    (sideSegments_disjoint :
                                                                        ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                          ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,

                                                        L.segEnd s e = none →
                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                                    (radial_test_const :
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                          (L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (height_test_affine :
                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                            ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                                (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                                        (degSide_pos : 1 ≤ L.degSide) →
                                                          (degSide_le : L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef) →
                                                            (cellCorner_spec :
                                                                ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                                  L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                                    L.corner c =
                                                                      (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂,
                                                                        if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                                              (cellCorner_axis :
                                                                  ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                    L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                                (sideSegments_spec :
                                                                    ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                      ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                        ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                                          (L.segment s).level =
                                                                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                                            else
                                                                              if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂
                                                                              else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                                  (sideSegments_cover :
                                                                      ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                        (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                                          ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                                            (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                                              else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                                              ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                                (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧
                                                                                  u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                                    (sideSegments_disjoint :
                                                                        ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                          ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                            ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                              s ≠ s' →
                                                                                (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                                  (L.segment s').hi ≤
                                                                                    (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                                      (segments_on_sides :
                                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                                            ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                                        (segment_orthonormal :
                                                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                                              d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                  ∫ (u : ℝ) in
                                                                                      Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo
                                                                                        (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                                      (L.segment s).test d u *
                                                                                        (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                                    if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                                          motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.centreDefect.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (freq : ℝ) (lam : Fin k → ℝ) (b : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (p : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → ℝ)
  (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
  Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.centreDefect freq lam b W H p σ y =
    freq • Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.timeDeriv W σ y + (1 / 2) • W σ y + (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) y -
              Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H σ y) +
            Breakdown.advectionAt (W σ) y +
          ∑ l, lam l • b l σ y +
        gradient (p σ) y -
      gradient (fun y' => ‖W σ y'‖ ^ 2 / 2) y

  (pt : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → ℝ) (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
  Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.linearDefect freq freqi lam b W Wi Hi pt σ y =

declarations.name: Breakdown.Cert.Internal.SupBound.core_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  N = 1 ∨ N = 2 →
    ∀ {P w₀ Wm fb Ab vn : ℝ},
      0 < P →
        0 < w₀ →
          ∀ {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ},
            Measurable w →
              (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w₀ ≤ w y) →
                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ Wm) →
                  0 ≤ fb →
                    ∀ (u : ↥Breakdown.Cert.XX) (f B A C : ↥Breakdown.Cert.HH)
                      (cv : Breakdown.Cert.TimeCircle → ↥Breakdown.Cert.HBar) (y : ℝ → ℝ),
                      Continuous y →
                        (∀ (σ : ℝ), y (σ + 1) = y σ) →
                          (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), y σ = ‖Breakdown.Cert.gradPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u ↑σ)‖ ^ 2) →
                            (∀ (a b : ℝ),
                                a ≤ b →
                                  1 / (2 * P) * (y b - y a) =
                                    ∫ (σ : ℝ) in a..b,
                                      inner ℝ (↑↑f ↑σ) (Breakdown.Cert.secondPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u ↑σ)) -
                                          ‖Breakdown.Cert.secondPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u ↑σ)‖ ^ 2 -
                                        1 / 4 * y σ) →
                              (N = 2 → ∀ (σ : ℝ), y (σ + 1 / 2) = y σ) →
                                (∀ᵐ (t : Breakdown.Cert.TimeCircle),
                                    -fb *
                                        (‖Breakdown.Cert.secondPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u t)‖ ^ 2 +
                                          Breakdown.Cert.sliceWeightedGrad w
                                            (Breakdown.Cert.gradPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u t))) ≤
                                      ‖Breakdown.Cert.secondPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u t)‖ ^ 2 +
                                          1 / 4 * ‖Breakdown.Cert.gradPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u t)‖ ^ 2 +
                                        inner ℝ (cv t) (Breakdown.Cert.secondPart (Breakdown.Cert.sliceOf u t))) →
                                  ↑↑C =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] cv →
                                    B = f + C + A →
                                      ‖A‖ ≤ Ab * vn →
                                        ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                          y σ ≤
                                            (1 / w₀ + 2 * (P / ↑N) * fb) * Breakdown.Cert.energyW w u +
                                              2 * (P / ↑N) * (‖B‖ + Ab * vn) * √(Breakdown.Cert.energyW w u)

declarations.type:

    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
              {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.EliminationConditions D R A S → Sort u} →
                (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.EliminationConditions D R A S) →
                  ((mesh_valid : Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh) →
                      (residual_value_le :
                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                            S K x →
                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue
                                  (R.cellForm K - Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.energyLeafForm D R K) x ≤
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).potentialKept x +
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x -
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).top x +
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandEliminated D K (A.blocks K) x +
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowsEliminated D K (A.blocks K) x) →
                        (band_weight_pos :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                (∀ (j : Fin 9),
                                    0 < (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) ∧
                                  ∀ (b : Fin 3), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑b, ⋯⟩) →
                          (band_turn :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ι ≠ 0 ∧
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ι ^ 2 ≠ 1) →
                            (band_slack :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).bandSlack ∧ (A.blocks K).bandSlack < 1) →
                              (slack_zero :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    (A.blocks K).bandSlack = 0 →
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                        ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                          S K x →
                                            ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 9),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.turnedSource D (A.blocks K) ι x p j =
                                                ↑((A.blocks K).bandWeight ι (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) *
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).bandMap ι) x p
                                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) →
                                (fields_bounded :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                        ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                                          (∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.FarFieldConditions.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {Tb : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.FarFieldValueSets} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.FarFieldConditions D Tb → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.FarFieldConditions D Tb) →
              ((chart_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.IsChartParams Tb.chart) →
                  (strain_enclosed :
                      ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                        ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                          inner ℝ
                              ((Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf D.given σ
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                u)
                              u ≤
                            Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.strain
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) *
                              ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                    (mean_enclosed :
                        ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.opBound
                            (fun a b =>
                              Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess) p (a, b))
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                              (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p))) →
                      (wave_enclosed :
                          ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                              ‖(Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess σ
                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                      u -
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellMatField.frameMap θ fun a b =>
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess) p (a, b)).re)
                                      u‖ ≤
                                Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) *
                                  ‖u‖) →
                        (charges_eq :
                            ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                              ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                                (D.charges none).curl ι p =
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.strain
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                                  (D.charges none).product ι p =
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                                    (D.charges none).gradient ι p =
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p)) →
                          (length_common :
                              ∀ (ι ι' : ℤ × ℤ),
                                ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                                  (D.charges none).length ι p = (D.charges none).length ι' p) →
                            (length_pos :
                                ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                  ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                                    0 < (D.charges none).length ι p) →
                              (valueSets_nonneg :
                                  ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                                    0 ≤
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                                      0 ≤
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p)) →
                                motive ⋯) →
                motive t

∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∀ ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
        ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            (((∑ i,
                      if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                        (P.potential K).groupStrain i / (P.potential K).groupBalance i
                      else 0) +
                    if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι else 0) +
                  if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                    (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longStrain +
                      (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl
                  else 0) ≤
                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
              ((((∑ i,
                          if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                            (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).length * (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                              (P.potential K).groupBalance i
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι else 0) +
                      if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) +
                    if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longGrad) *
                            (P.potential K).epsLength +
                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel)
                    else 0) ≤
                  (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
                (((∑ i,
                          if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                            (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                              ((P.potential K).length * (P.potential K).groupBalance i)
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakVel ι else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                        3 / (2 * √2) *
                          (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longGrad) /
                              (P.potential K).length +
                            (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain)
                      else 0) +
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.creditVelDemand D R K ι p ≤
                  (R.entryCharges K ι).velCharge p

  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
      Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsCrossWaveEntry ((P.potential K).groupWave i) ∧
        ((P.potential K).groupWave i).azimuthOrder = D.azimuthOrder ∧
          ((P.potential K).groupWave i).region = (D.mesh.box K).rect ∧
            ((P.potential K).groupWave i).strainBound = (P.potential K).groupStrain i ∧
              ((P.potential K).groupWave i).vorticityGradBound = (P.potential K).groupGrad i ∧
                ((P.potential K).groupWave i).balance = (P.potential K).groupBalance i ∧
                  ((P.potential K).groupWave i).length = (P.potential K).length ∧
                    (P.potential K).groupHarmonics i =
                        Finset.image (fun n => (n, (P.potential K).groupShift i))
                          ((P.potential K).groupWave i).waveModes ∧
                      (∀ (n : ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (a b : Fin 3),
                          ((P.potential K).groupWave i).strainMode n p (a, b) =
                            D.model.strain.planeValue D.mesh.box K (n, (P.potential K).groupShift i) a b p) ∧
                        (∀ (n : ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (a b : Fin 3),
                            Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (((P.potential K).groupWave i).vorticityGradMode n p)
                                (a, b) =
                              D.model.vorticityGrad.planeValue D.mesh.box K (n, (P.potential K).groupShift i) a b p) ∧
                          ((P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(7 / 2) →
                            ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (θ : ℝ),
                              ∑ j,
                                  ∑ n ∈ ((P.potential K).groupWave i).waveModes,
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.azimuthPhase D.azimuthOrder n θ *
                                      Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv
                                        (((P.potential K).groupWave i).vorticityGradMode n p) (j, j) =
                                0)

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).potentialKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.potentialExact D R K (P.potential K) x -
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highOwnAmount D K (P.potential K) (D.mesh.resolved K)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperProfiles D R K (P.potential K) x)) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
            S K x →
              ∑ ι,
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι true /
                      (P.potential K).strainBalance ↑ι +
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι false /
                      (P.potential K).velBalance ↑ι) ≤
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (P.potential K).portForm x) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, 0 < (P.potential K).strainBalance ι ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).velBalance ι) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                0 < (P.potential K).groupBalance i ∧
                  0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupStrain i ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupGrad i) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).length) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).epsLength) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                      (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(7 / 2) ∨ (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(9 / 2)) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsStrain ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsGrad) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                            (R.leaves K).strainAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).strainBalance ι +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                  (2 * (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                    3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) ≤
                              (A.blocks K).potentialStrainCost ι) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                              (R.leaves K).velocityAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).velBalance ι +
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                    (3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) ≤
                                (A.blocks K).potentialVelCost ι) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (α : ℤ × ℤ),
                              α ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels ↔
                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic D.azimuthOrder α ∈ D.givenLabels) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                    S K x →
                                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 12),
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).potentialSource ι') x p
                                            j =
                                          ∑ ι,
                                            ∑ j',
                                              (P.potential K).couplingModel (ι' - ↑ι) p j j' *
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.lowProfile D R K ι
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperPart D R K (P.potential K) x) p
                                                  j') →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K) (j : Fin 12),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>
                                        (A.blocks K).potentialSource ι d p j) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    (D.modelErrors K).strainHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highStrain ∧
                                      (D.modelErrors K).vorticityGradHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highGrad) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      0 < (P.potential K).youngCurl ∧
                                        0 < (P.potential K).youngStrain ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).youngVel) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                            (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                        (P.potential K).longStrain +
                                                    (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                                  (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ≤
                                                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
                                              ((⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) *
                                                            (P.potential K).epsLength +
                                                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) +
                                                    if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
                                                (⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) /
                                                            (P.potential K).length +
                                                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) +
                                                    (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι ≤
                                                  (R.entryCharges K ι).velCharge p) →

∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            p.1 *
              ∑ l,
                ∑ c,
                  ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                        Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                    2 ≤
        (A.blocks K).actuatorErr

declarations.type:

  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun p => Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun p => p.1 * ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c‖ ^ 2)
          (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume

  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},

            (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost * ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
              2 * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K) ι * (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
            (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
        (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost * ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
              2 * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K) ι * (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
            if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
              (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) * (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^ 2
            else 0) ≤
          (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R} →
              {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S → Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S) →
                    ((cell_conditions : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R) →
                        (row_map :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount)
                              (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                              S K x →
                                (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
                                  (∑ ι,
                                        if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                                          ∑ d,
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                                                (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                                                (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) *
                                                  D.model.periodInverse)
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                                        else 0) +
                                      ∑ ι',
                                        ∑ d,
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K
                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K
                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
                                    ∑ l,
                                      x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                          (row_band :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p =
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
                            (row_tail :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                      ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                                        (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                                            (D.mesh.box K).proj
                                              (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                              else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                              (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                              else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                              (fun p' =>
                                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                                              p) →
                              (partners_leak :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                    (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                                (leak_curl :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                        ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                              ∑ g,
                                                if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2
                                                else 0) +
                                            if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                  ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                  (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                                            else 0) ≤
                                          (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
                                  (leak_vel :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                          ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                                ∑ g,
                                                  if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then
                                                    (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2
                                                  else 0) +
                                              if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                                2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                      2 +
                                                  2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                    (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                                              else 0) ≤
                                            (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                                    (tests_valid :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                                              (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                  ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                                                (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                    ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                                                  ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                                ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                                                    ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                                                    ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                                      (rows_groups_cover :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                              ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                                  ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                                                    ∃ g,
                                                      ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧
                                                        ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                                        (sources_leak :
                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆
                                                (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                                          (actuator_pos :
                                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                            (actuator_kappa :
                                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                  (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤
                                                    (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                                              (actuator_err :
                                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                    ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                          p.1 *
                                                            ∑ l,
                                                              ∑ c,
                                                                ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                        (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                        ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                                                  2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                                (actuator_model_regular :
                                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                                      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                          (fun p =>
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                              ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                                          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                                          (fun p =>
                                                            p.1 *
                                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                    ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c‖ ^
                                                                2)
                                                          (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                  (actuator_off_rows :
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                                        (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                                          ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K
                                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K
                                                                  (A.blocks K) i)
                                                                (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K
                                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K
                                                                  (A.blocks K) i)
                                                                ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                                    (pair_slack_pos :
                                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                          ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                                      (box_strain_pair :
                                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                              ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K →
                                                                R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                                        (costs_pos :
                                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                              0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                                                0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                                                  0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                                                    0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                                                        0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                                          (leak_budget :
                                                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                                                  (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                                      ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                                              if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then
                                                                                0
                                                                              else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                                            ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups
                                                                                    (P.potential K) ι).card /
                                                                              (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K
                                                                            (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then
                                                                          1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                                        else 0) ≤
                                                                    1) →
                                                            (box_curl_rows :
                                                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                                    2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                                              (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                                            2 +
                                                                        2 *
                                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D
                                                                              R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                          (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                      (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                                              (box_velocity_rows :
                                                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                                      (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                                                  (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                                                2 +
                                                                            2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                  D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                              (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
                                                                          if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
                                                                            (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                                                                              (2 * Real.pi *
                                                                                    ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) *
                                                                                  (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^
                                                                                2
                                                                          else 0) ≤
                                                                        (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι) →
                                                                (band_allowance_rows :
                                                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                                                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                                ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                                                    (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                                                  2 +
                                                                              2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                    D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                                (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                            (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
                                                                          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                                ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                                                    (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                                                  2 +
                                                                              2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                    D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                                (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                            (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι) →
                                                                  (group_velocity :
                                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count)
                                                                        (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                                        ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                                          ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                                            (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                                                ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase
                                                                                      D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity
                                                                                      D K α p a) ≤
                                                                              (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2) →
                                                                    (group_curl :
                                                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count)
                                                                          (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                                          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                                            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                                              (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                                                  ∑
                                                                                    α ∈
                                                                                      (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase
                                                                                        D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity
                                                                                        D K α p a) ≤
                                                                                (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2) →
                                                                      (period_box :
                                                                          ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                              |1 / D.cert.period q -
                                                                                    D.model.periodInverse| ≤
                                                                                (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) →
                                                                        motive ⋯) →
                      motive t

∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
      ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,

    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),

declarations.type:
