∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
        S K x →
          (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
            (∑ ι,
                  if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                    ∑ d,
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                          (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                  else 0) +
                ∑ ι',
                  ∑ d,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
              ∑ l,
                x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
          ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
              (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p = Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
            ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                  (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                    ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                      (D.mesh.box K).proj
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (fun p' =>
                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                        p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
              (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                  ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                        ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2 else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost * ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                          2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                      else 0) ≤
                    (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                    ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                          ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2 else 0) +
                        if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
                            2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                        else 0) ≤
                      (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                            ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                          ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                        ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                          ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                            ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                              ∃ g, ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧ ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤ (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                  ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    p.1 *
                                      ∑ l,
                                        ∑ c,
                                          ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                  ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                            2 ≤
                                (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                    (fun p =>
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                    (fun p =>
                                      p.1 *
                                        ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p
                                              c‖ ^
                                          2)
                                    (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                    ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K → R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                          0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                            0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                              0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K, 0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                            (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                        if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then 0
                                                        else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                      ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups (P.potential K)
                                                              ι).card /
                                                        (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                  if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then 1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                  else 0) ≤
                                              1) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                  2 * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                    (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                        ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                          2 +
                                                      2 *
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K)
                                                            ι *
                                                        (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
                                                    if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
                                                      (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                                                        (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) *
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^
                                                          2
                                                    else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι) →
                                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                                  2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                              (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
                                                    2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                              (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι) →
                                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                    ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                      (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                          ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K α p a) ≤
                                                        (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2) →
                                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                      ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                        (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                            ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K α p a) ≤
                                                          (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                        |1 / D.cert.period q - D.model.periodInverse| ≤
                                                          (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) →
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S

                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p =
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
                            (row_tail :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                      ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                                        (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                                            (D.mesh.box K).proj
                                              (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                              else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                              (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                              else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                              (fun p' =>
                                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                                              p) →
                              (partners_leak :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                    (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                                (leak_curl :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                        ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                              ∑ g,
                                                if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2
                                                else 0) +
                                            if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                  ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                  (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                                            else 0) ≤
                                          (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
                                  (leak_vel :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                          ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                                ∑ g,
                                                  if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then
                                                    (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2
                                                  else 0) +
                                              if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                                2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                      2 +
                                                  2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                    (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                                              else 0) ≤
                                            (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                                    (tests_valid :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                                              (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                  ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                                                (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                    ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                                                  ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                                ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                                                    ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                                                    ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                                      (rows_groups_cover :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                              ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                                  ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                                                    ∃ g,
                                                      ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧
                                                        ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                                        (sources_leak :
                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆
                                                (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                                          (actuator_pos :
                                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                            (actuator_kappa :
                                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                  (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤
                                                    (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →

                                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                    ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                          p.1 *
                                                            ∑ l,
                                                              ∑ c,
                                                                ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                        (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                        ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                                                  2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                                (actuator_model_regular :
                                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                                      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                          (fun p =>
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                              ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                                          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                                          (fun p =>
                                                            p.1 *
                                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                    ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c‖ ^
                                                                2)
                                                          (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                  (actuator_off_rows :
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                                        (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                                          ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K
                                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K
                                                                  (A.blocks K) i)
                                                                (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K
                                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K
                                                                  (A.blocks K) i)
                                                                ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                                    (pair_slack_pos :
                                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                          ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                                      (box_strain_pair :

                                                              ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K →
                                                                R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                                        (costs_pos :
                                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                              0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                                                0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                                                  0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                                                    0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                                                        0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                                          (leak_budget :
                                                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                                                  (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                                      ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                                              if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then
                                                                                0
                                                                              else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                                            ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups
                                                                                    (P.potential K) ι).card /
                                                                              (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K
                                                                            (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then
                                                                          1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                                        else 0) ≤
                                                                    1) →
                                                            (box_curl_rows :
                                                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                                    2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                                              (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                                            2 +
                                                                        2 *
                                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D
                                                                              R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                          (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                      (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                                              (box_velocity_rows :
                                                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                                      (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                                                  (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                                                2 +
                                                                            2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                  D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                              (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
                                                                          if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
                                                                            (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                                                                              (2 * Real.pi *
                                                                                    ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) *
                                                                                  (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^
                                                                                2
                                                                          else 0) ≤
                                                                        (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι) →
                                                                (band_allowance_rows :
                                                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                                                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                                ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                                                    (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^

                                                                              2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                    D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                                (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                            (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
                                                                          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                                ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                                                    (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                                                  2 +
                                                                              2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                    D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                                (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                            (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι) →
                                                                  (group_velocity :
                                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count)
                                                                        (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),

                                                                                      D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *

                                                                                      D K α p a) ≤

                                                                          (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                                          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                                            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                                              (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                                                  ∑
                                                                                    α ∈
                                                                                      (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase
                                                                                        D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity
                                                                                        D K α p a) ≤
                                                                                (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2) →

Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions.row_map
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
      S K x →
        (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
          (∑ ι,
                if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                  ∑ d,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                        (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                else 0) +
              ∑ ι',
                ∑ d,
                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
            ∑ l,
              x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)

declarations.type:
∀ (K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox) (m : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (Q : ℕ)
  (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
  (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.labelStrainTail K m ι Q G H =
    ∑ a,
      ∑ b,
        (K.tailGradWeight Q (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt m ι G a b)
            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.slopeAt m ι H a b 0)
            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.slopeAt m ι H a b 2) +
          K.angularWeight ι.1 * K.tailNormSq Q (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.turnedSlopeAt m ι H a b))

declarations.type:
∀ (K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox) (m : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (Q : ℕ)
  (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
  (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.labelVorticityTail K m ι Q G H =
    ∑ i,
      ((K.tailGradWeight Q
          (fun p =>
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlComp (fun a b => Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt m ι G a b p) i)
          (fun p =>
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlComp (fun a b => Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.slopeAt m ι H a b 0 p)
              i)
          fun p =>
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlComp (fun a b => Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.slopeAt m ι H a b 2 p)

          K.tailNormSq Q fun p =>
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlComp
              (fun a b => Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.turnedSlopeAt m ι H a b p) i)

  Module.finrank ℝ ↥{ toFun := fun x c => T.column c ⬝ᵥ x, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }.range +

        Fintype.card T.Column ≤ Fintype.card B →
          ¬Fintype.card A ≤
                Module.finrank ℝ ↥{ toFun := fun x c => T.column c ⬝ᵥ x, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }.ker →
            False

                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                          (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).hess ∧
                                    (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ≤
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                            (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧
                                      (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ≤
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                              (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curl ∧
                                        (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ≤
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                                (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).strain ∧
                                          (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity ≤
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                                (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →

                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),

declarations.type:

∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  Finite C →
    0 < m.c →
      m.c < 1 →
        0 < m.cμ →
          m.cμ < 1 →
            0 < P →
              0 < w₀ →
                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w₀ ≤ w y) →
                  Measurable w →
                    Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric w →
                      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, -β ∈ h.harmonics) →
                        (0, 0) ∈ h.harmonics →
                          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space) (i : Fin 3),
                              (W σ y).ofLp i = ∑ β ∈ h.harmonics, (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y i).re) →
                            (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                              (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                  ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                      h.ampGradW β y) →
                                (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                            (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                        h.ampVort β y) →
                                  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                              (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                          h.ampGradVort β y) →
                                    (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                                      (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                            h.supGradVort y) →
                                        (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                  (m.epsP β).frame •
                                                    (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                      (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                              (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                          (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                    (m.muP β).frame •
                                                      (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                        (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                                (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                            (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                                ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                  ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                                    Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                              (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                                  ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                    ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                      Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                    (∑ β,
                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                            (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                        2 ≤
                                                      ratio *
                                                        ∑ β,
                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                              |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                            (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                                  0 ≤ ratio →
                                                    (∀ (β : Fin nE) (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ (m.epsP β).wt y) →
                                                      (∀ (β : Fin nM) (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                                        (∀ (β : Fin nE), ∃ K, LipschitzWith K (m.epsP β).wt) →
                                                          (∀ (β : Fin nM), ∃ K, LipschitzWith K (m.muP β).wt) →
                                                            (∀ (β : Fin nE), Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric (m.epsP β).wt) →
                                                              (∀ (β : Fin nM), Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric (m.muP β).wt) →
                                                                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                    ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                                                  (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                      ∑ β,
                                                                          Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt
                                                                            y ≤
                                                                        epsGradSup) →
                                                                    (∃ B,
                                                                        ∀ (β : Fin nE) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                          ‖y‖ * (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ B) →
                                                                      (∃ B,
                                                                          ∀ (β : Fin nM) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            (m.muP β).wt y ≤ B ∧
                                                                              ⋯ * (m.muP β).wt y ≤ B ∧
                                                                                ⋯ *
                                                                                    Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad
                                                                                      (m.muP β).wt y ≤
                                                                                  B) →
                                                                        (∀ (β : Fin nE) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            0 < (m.epsP β).share1 y ∧
                                                                              0 < (m.epsP β).share2 y ∧
                                                                                0 < (m.epsP β).len y ∧
                                                                                  0 < (m.epsP β).t0 y ∧ ⋯) →
                                                                          (∀ (β : Fin nM) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                              0 < (m.muP β).share y ∧
                                                                                0 < (m.muP β).t4 y) →
                                                                            (∀ (β : Fin nM), 0 < (m.muP β).eta) →
                                                                              (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                                                                  Measurable (m.epsP β).share1 ∧
                                                                                    ⋯ ∧ ⋯) →
                                                                                (∀ (β : Fin nM), ⋯ ∧ ⋯) →
                                                                                  (∀ (β : Fin nE), ⋯) →
                                                                                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                                                                        Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric
                                                                                            (m.muP β).share ∧
                                                                                          Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric
                                                                                            (m.muP β).t4) →
                                                                                      ⋯

      ∀ q ∈ d.params,
        ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
          (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
          (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
          Breakdown.IsPerturbation d.symmetries (d.period q) v G H g →
            ∀ (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                  (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                    Breakdown.IsRightSide (d.profile q) d.actuator 0 v G g F →
                      |Breakdown.periodPairing F (d.adjoint j q) -

                        d.adjointDefect j * √(Breakdown.weightedEnergy d.weightFn G H)

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k},
  Breakdown.IsExtendedCertificate d →
    ∀ q ∈ d.params,
      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
        Breakdown.IsPerturbation d.symmetries (d.period q) v G H g →
          ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
              Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                  Breakdown.IsRightSide (d.model q) d.actuator κ v G g F →
                    √(Breakdown.weightedEnergy d.weightFn G H + d.multiplierWeight ^ 2 * ∑ i, κ i ^ 2) ≤
                      d.coerciveL2 * Breakdown.periodNorm F + d.rows F +
                        d.coercivePin * Breakdown.vecNorm fun i => Breakdown.pinValue (d.pin i) G

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM) (P : ℝ) (h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds)
  (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
  (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (σ : ℝ)
  (y : Breakdown.Space),
  m.modeTerm P h w v G H ι σ y =
    m.modeDensity P h w ι y √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv ι H σ y))
      √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv ι H σ y)))
      √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad ι G σ y))
      √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad ι G σ y)))
      √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel ι v σ y))

declarations.type: Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotentialSeries → Prop

{F : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotentialSeries} →
  {motive : Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialSeries F → Sort u} →
    (t : Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialSeries F) →
      ((theta_scalar :
            ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
              ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialScalar 2 2 ((F.data κ).theta c)) →
          (phi_scalar :
              ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialScalar 2 1 ((F.data κ).phi c)) →
            (theta_axis :
                ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                  κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
                    ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                      1 ≤ ((F.data κ).theta c).axisPower ∨
                        Breakdown.PotentialShape.AxisCellsVanish ((F.data κ).theta c).amp) →
              (phi_axis :
                  ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                    κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
                      ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                        1 ≤ ((F.data κ).phi c).axisPower ∨
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.AxisCellsVanish ((F.data κ).phi c).amp) →
                (radialFlux_mesh :
                    ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                      ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetAxis ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.tAxis 0 1 ∧
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsJetMesh ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.xAxis (-1) 1) →
                  (polarFlux_mesh :
                      ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                        ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsJetMesh ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.tAxis 0 1 ∧
                            Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetAxis ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.xAxis (-1) 1) →
                    (flux_end :
                        ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                          ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                            (∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
                                2 ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
                                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp z) ∧
                              ∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
                                2 ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
                                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp z) →
                      (pressure_class :
                          ∀ κ ∈ F.keys, Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetClass 0 0 (F.data κ).pressure.amp) →
                        (pressure_end :
                            ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                              ∃ z ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.amp.tAxis.depth,
                                2 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.highOrder + z ∧
                                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder (F.data κ).pressure.amp z) →
                          (pressure_axis :
                              ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                                κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
                                  1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.axisPower ∧
                                    (1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.lowOrder ∨
                                      Breakdown.PotentialShape.StartVanishOrder (F.data κ).pressure.amp 1)) →
                            (pressure_start :
                                ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                                  κ.label.1 = 0 →
                                    1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.lowOrder ∨
                                      Breakdown.PotentialShape.StartRowConstant (F.data κ).pressure.amp) →
                              motive ⋯) →
        motive t

    ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
      ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
        (∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
            2 ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
              Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp z) ∧
          ∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
            2 ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
              Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp z

declarations.type:
∀ {F : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotentialSeries},
  (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
      ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
        Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialScalar 2 2 ((F.data κ).theta c)) →
    (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
        ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
          Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialScalar 2 1 ((F.data κ).phi c)) →
      (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
          κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
            ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
              1 ≤ ((F.data κ).theta c).axisPower ∨ Breakdown.PotentialShape.AxisCellsVanish ((F.data κ).theta c).amp) →
        (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
            κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
              ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                1 ≤ ((F.data κ).phi c).axisPower ∨ Breakdown.PotentialShape.AxisCellsVanish ((F.data κ).phi c).amp) →
          (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
              ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetAxis ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.tAxis 0 1 ∧
                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsJetMesh ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.xAxis (-1) 1) →
            (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsJetMesh ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.tAxis 0 1 ∧
                    Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetAxis ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.xAxis (-1) 1) →
              (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                  ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent),
                    (∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
                        2 ≤ ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).radialFlux c).amp z) ∧
                      ∃ z ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp.tAxis.depth,
                        2 ≤ ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).highOrder + z ∧
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder ((F.data κ).polarFlux c).amp z) →
                (∀ κ ∈ F.keys, Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsJetClass 0 0 (F.data κ).pressure.amp) →
                  (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                      ∃ z ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.amp.tAxis.depth,
                        2 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.highOrder + z ∧
                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.EndVanishOrder (F.data κ).pressure.amp z) →
                    (∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
                        κ.label.1 ≠ 0 →
                          1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.axisPower ∧
                            (1 ≤ (F.data κ).pressure.lowOrder ∨
                              Breakdown.PotentialShape.StartVanishOrder (F.data κ).pressure.amp 1)) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.casesOn
declarations.type:
{X : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X] →
      [inst_2 : CompleteSpace X] →
        {motive : Breakdown.Realization X → Sort u} →
          (t : Breakdown.Realization X) →
            ((F : Breakdown.MildFramework X) →
                (rot : (Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) → X ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] X) →
                  (rot_commutes : ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space), F.Commutes (rot R)) →
                    (embed : (Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) → X) →
                      (embed_sub :
                          ∀ (f g : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.IsDecayField f → Breakdown.IsDecayField g → embed (f - g) = embed f - embed g) →
                        (embed_norm :
                            ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                              Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                ‖embed f‖ ^ 2 =
                                  ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ‖(fderiv ℝ f y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)‖ ^ 2) →
                          (embed_ne_zero :
                              ∀ (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (∃ y, f y ≠ 0) → embed f ≠ 0) →
                            (embed_rot :
                                ∀ (R : Breakdown.Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                  Breakdown.IsDecayField f → (rot R) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.pushForward R f)) →
                              (embed_dilate :
                                  ∀ (μ : ℝ) (f : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                    0 < μ →
                                      Breakdown.IsDecayField f →
                                        (F.D μ) (embed f) = embed (Breakdown.dilateField μ f)) →
                                (mild_of_weak :
                                    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
                                      a < b →
                                        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
                                          ContinuousOn (fun t => embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
                                            (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2)
                                                    MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                              (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                                                  Filter.Tendsto
                                                    (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2)
                                                    (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b)) (nhds 0)) →
                                                (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                                                        HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                          (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ -
                                                            Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ)
                                                          t) →
                                                  (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                      Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                                                        ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                                                          (Set.Icc a b)) →
                                                    F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => embed (v t)) a b) →
                                  (test : Submodule ℝ X) →
                                    (test_dense : Dense ↑test) →
                                      (test_spec : ∀ x ∈ test, ∃ φ, Breakdown.IsTestField φ ∧ embed φ = x) →
                                        motive
                                          { F := F, rot := rot, rot_commutes := rot_commutes, embed := embed,
                                            embed_sub := embed_sub, embed_norm := embed_norm,
                                            embed_ne_zero := embed_ne_zero, embed_rot := embed_rot,
                                            embed_dilate := embed_dilate, mild_of_weak := mild_of_weak, test := test,
                                            test_dense := test_dense, test_spec := test_spec }) →
              motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.Realization.mild_of_weak
declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace X]
  (self : Breakdown.Realization X) (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (a b : ℝ),
  a < b →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, Breakdown.IsDecayField (v t)) →
      ContinuousOn (fun t => self.embed (v t)) (Set.Icc a b) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
            ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc a b, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖v t x - v t' x‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
          (∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
              Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ (x : Breakdown.Space), ‖v t x - v t₀ x‖ ^ 2) (nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Icc a b))
                (nhds 0)) →
            (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                Breakdown.IsTestField φ →
                  ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
                    HasDerivAt (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ)
                      (-Breakdown.gradientPairing (v t) φ - Breakdown.advectionPairing (v t) φ) t) →
              (∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                  Breakdown.IsTestField φ → ContinuousOn (fun τ => Breakdown.fieldPairing (v τ) φ) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                self.F.IsMildOnIcc (fun t => self.embed (v t)) a b

declarations.name: Breakdown.sigmaSimilarityIntegrand.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (P : ℝ) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
  (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
  Breakdown.sigmaSimilarityIntegrand P W G φ z =
    -(1 / P) * inner ℝ (W z.1 z.2) (deriv (fun σ => φ σ z.2) z.1) - inner ℝ (W z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2) -
          1 / 2 * inner ℝ (W z.1 z.2) ((fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) z.2) +
        ∑ i, inner ℝ ((G z.1 z.2) (Breakdown.unitVector i)) ((fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) (Breakdown.unitVector i)) -
      ∑ i, (W z.1 z.2).ofLp i * inner ℝ (W z.1 z.2) ((fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) (Breakdown.unitVector i))

declarations.name: Breakdown.weakDefectField.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P : ℝ) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (Hs : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
  (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (b : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (lam : Fin k → ℝ)
  (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
  Breakdown.weakDefectField P W Hs g b lam σ y =
    (1 / P) • deriv (fun s => W s y) σ + (1 / 2) • W σ y + (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) y -
            Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (Hs σ y) +
          Breakdown.advectionAt (W σ) y +
        ∑ i, lam i • b i σ y +
      g σ y
